nodes.label: countActiveSeats() — Seat Locking with PENDING Requests
nodes.rationale: PENDING requests (PENDING_SECURITY | PENDING_ADMIN) are counted alongside active assignments to prevent over-allocation before final approval.
nodes.norm_label: countactiveseats() — seat locking with pending requests

nodes.label: approveAdmin() Service Function
nodes.rationale: Re-checks countActiveSeats() at approval time to guard against race conditions where seats fill between request creation and admin approval.

nodes.label: Two-Stage License Approval Flow
nodes.rationale: Replaces direct assign() with TEAM_LEAD → SECURITY_OFFICER → ADMIN two-stage approval to enforce cost and security controls. LicenseAssignment is only created upon APPROVED status.

nodes.label: Seat Race Condition Guard at approveAdmin
nodes.rationale: approveAdmin() re-runs countActiveSeats() at final approval moment. If seats are exhausted the request stays PENDING_ADMIN for manual admin decision rather than being auto-rejected.
